{'text': '家長被呼籲趁新學年開始，重新審視子女使用電子螢幕的時間限制。有意見指出，壓力大的家長在暑假期間可能對子女使用螢幕的態度較為放任，但這種做法在學期開始後可能對孩子造成嚴重的不利影響。', 'source': '', 'target': "Parents are being urged to reconsider limits on their children's screen time as the new school year begins. It has been suggested that stressed parents may have been more lenient with screen usage during the summer holidays, but this approach could have serious detrimental effects on children once the school term starts."}

{'text': '此外，專家指出，以往建議的每日兩小時上限已經過時，家長應該採取更為細緻的方式，根據「5C原則」來處理……', 'source': '', 'target': "Additionally, experts have noted that the previously recommended two-hour daily limit is outdated, and parents should adopt a more nuanced approach based on the '5 Cs'..."}

{'text': 'CNET指出，孩子整天在家時，家長的壓力會更大，因而更依賴電子裝置來讓孩子有事可做。', 'source': '', 'target': 'CNET noted that parents face greater pressure when children are at home all day, making them more reliant on electronic devices to keep their kids occupied.'}

{'text': '專家表示，這種情況未必構成問題。', 'source': '', 'target': 'Experts say this may not necessarily be a problem.'}

{'text': '但若孩子在重返校園後仍未作出調整，則可能令他們面臨風險。', 'source': '', 'target': 'However, if children fail to adjust after returning to school, they could be at risk.'}

{'text': '兒童發展專家指出，過度使用電子媒介可能導致學業成績下降、專注力受損及認知能力減弱。', 'source': '', 'target': 'Child development experts have pointed out that excessive use of digital media may lead to declining academic performance, impaired concentration, and reduced cognitive abilities.'}
